name: Sanagōchi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sanagōchi village emblem in light blue and orange: a light blue ring enclosing an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Sanagōchi, a village in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 March 1980.

features.role: Sanagōchi village emblem — a light blue ring enclosing an orange disc
